item.title: Spider Buddy 0.8.0
item.description:
## What's new
**Updates look after themselves now.** Spider Buddy checks for new versions once a day, using [Sparkle](https://sparkle-project.org), the updater many Mac apps use.
- Each update shows what's new before you install it, then installs in place and relaunches. - An update found in the background never pops up over your work. An **Update to …** button appears at the top of the panel instead. - Every download and the update feed are cryptographically signed, and the app checks both before installing anything. - New switches on the panel's **App** page: **Check Automatically** (daily) and **Install Automatically**, which installs quietly the next time the app quits.
**Coming from 0.7.0 or earlier?** Click **Check for Updates** on the App page once to install this version. From then on, updates arrive on their own.
